notes: Fictional employer for the HR-compliance demo. Covered employer under FMLA (300+ employees company-wide). Jurisdiction, worksite headcount, and pay params resolve per site; employees link to a site via site_id.

sites.name: Austin HQ
sites.description: Headquarters. Large worksite (>=50 within 75 miles), so employees here pass the FMLA worksite test. Texas has no state wage floor above federal, so FLSA (federal) applies.

sites.name: San Jose Regional Office
sites.description: West Coast regional office. Large worksite (>=50 within 75 miles). California overlay applies: higher minimum wage and daily overtime.

sites.name: Permian Basin Field Project
sites.description: Remote engineering field project. Only 18 employees within 75 miles and no other Northwind site nearby, so employees assigned here FAIL the FMLA 50/75-mile worksite test even though the employer is covered company-wide. Teaching point: employer coverage != employee eligibility.
